about: The 2025 constants of the final line: every fitted or hand-set number, its provenance and where the code holds it. This file documents the values; the scripts keep their own copies (the code that built the submitted file is unchanged), and tools/check_constants.py checks that every code literal listed here is present in its file. Fitted files are written by scripts/constants_2025.sh (make constants) to the paths under fitted_files, which scripts/run_final.sh checks before a run; the ones under scratchpad/ are derived from competition data and are not published. No value was set from a leaderboard score.

constants.name: pool_weights
constants.provenance: global simplex fit on the 6-fold vectors of the three chains, matched 2025 rows (scripts/pool_weights_fit.py, make constants step pool); unrounded fit in phase2/params/pool_weights.json; the code uses the 4-decimal values (the 5-slot pool_mix call writes the NNA3 weight as 0.3722)

constants.name: postrule_arms
constants.provenance: standfloor and offblock_pull: one arm (or none) per airport chosen from fixed grids on all 12 months of 2025 fold vectors (phase2/steps/p2_postrules.py fit, make constants step postrules); shifts rounded to 1 s

constants.name: postrule_grids
constants.provenance: candidate arms of the post-rule fit

code.literal: GRID = [(W, b, k) for W in (600, 900) for b in (0, 300) for k in (0.5, 1.0)]

constants.name: tw1_shift
constants.provenance: TW1' LFPG twin rule: n/(n+5) * mean(y - pred) over the 2025 class rows, rounded (scripts/tw1_rule_build.py, make constants step tw1 -> tw1p_shift.json)

constants.name: tw1_pair_window
constants.provenance: two departure records of one callsign at LFPG with |dMVT| <= 300 s form a pair

constants.name: tw1_shrink
constants.provenance: shrinkage n/(n+5) of the class mean

constants.name: krs_beta
constants.provenance: per tercile of the K250 instance spread, fitted on the 2025 fold rows of the line (scripts/krs_fold_line.sh, make constants step krs)

constants.name: krsnl_shrink
constants.provenance: KRS-NL: line + 0.5 * g

constants.name: krsnl_residual_clip
constants.provenance: clip of the KRS-line residual the LightGBM is fitted to

constants.name: krsnl_lightgbm
constants.provenance: KRS-NL residual model settings; the fitted model is a 2025 fit (make constants step krsnl)

constants.name: meta_stacker_clip
constants.provenance: correction of the chain meta stacker clipped to +-150 s

constants.name: clock_stage_clip
constants.provenance: Huber clock stage (Hu6) correction clipped to +-300 s

constants.name: callsign_link_step
constants.provenance: unmatched rows linked by callsign: + 1.0 * clip(g, +-1200)

constants.name: kumo_F1_F3
constants.provenance: in-context residual on linked (F1) and unlinked (F3) unmatched rows

constants.name: kumo_F4
constants.provenance: in-context residual on unmatched LIRF rows

constants.name: rule_bag_blend
constants.provenance: seed-bag blend of the rule-priced rows (24 LightGBM + 16 CatBoost seeds)

constants.name: pxsafe_ord_bounds
constants.provenance: 95 % exact one-sided upper bounds of the ORD share among 2025 exposed LIRF rows (0 of 40 crossers, 0 of 10 non-crossers; scripts/exposed_ord_bounds.py, make constants step exposed)

constants.name: pxsafe_margin
constants.provenance: a row moves only if its break-even ORD probability is at least twice its class bound

constants.name: e1s_clock_cap
constants.provenance: largest at-stand clock among the 21 linked 2025 exposed non-LIRF rows (scripts/e1s_clock_cap.py, make constants step exposed)

constants.name: tail_guard_threshold
constants.kind: chosen on 2025 from a fixed grid
constants.provenance: KCATLg uses the raw-target member where its prediction is above 2,400 s; one global value from the grid {1,800, 2,400, 3,600 s, KCAT8 q99}, chosen on the 2025 folds

constants.name: schedule_copy_join_edge
constants.provenance: the organisers' flight-plan join edge |BLOCK - LOBT| <= 3,600 s as measured on 2025

constants.name: scheduled_stamp_window
constants.provenance: exposed rows: unmatched and MVT - SCHED > 8 h

constants.name: lobt_bound
constants.provenance: |y - (MVT - LOBT)| <= 3,606 s holds for every 2025 row with LOBT

constants.name: floor
constants.provenance: prediction floor

fitted_files.name: unmatched_context_2025
fitted_files.written_by: scripts/constants_2025.sh exposed (2025 rows only; competition data, not published)
